description: This file defines an interface for managing entity fields in Drupal, including methods for retrieving and setting field definitions, storage definitions, field maps, and extra fields, as well as cache management.

classes.name: EntityFieldManagerInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing entity field definitions, storage, and related cache operations in Drupal.

methods.name: getBaseFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves base field definitions for a given entity type, excluding bundle-specific fields.

methods.name: getFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves field definitions for a specific bundle of an entity type.

methods.name: getFieldStorageDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves all field storage definitions for a content entity type.

methods.name: getFieldMap
methods.description: Returns a lightweight map of fields across bundles.

methods.name: setFieldMap
methods.description: Sets a lightweight map of fields across bundles.

methods.name: getFieldMapByFieldType
methods.description: Retrieves a map of fields filtered by a specific field type.

methods.name: clearCachedFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Clears static and persistent caches of field definitions.

methods.name: useCaches
methods.description: Enables or disables the use of caches.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Retrieves additional 'pseudo-field' elements for a bundle.

methods.name: getFieldLabels
methods.description: Returns labels used for a specific field on an entity type.
